selection: Use up to 1500 R1 source examples per seed, sharing the highest wrong class from an independent lexical MLP across random and difficulty-ranked masks. Choose by source hits at the corresponding cap.
human: An ID-hashed worker vote is the observed claim. Include a ternary claim when at least three of the other four workers agree on a ternary reference. Target R1 test and R2 train plus test, with duplicate normalized text removed and review groups isolated across roles.
profile: R1 dev groups are split by a fixed group hash into source and human development profiles. Evaluate R1 and R2 targets at every operating point from operating_envelope.json. R2 dev is unused.
